## Safety Checklist

The following must be verified before this review can be approved:

### Consent and Boundaries
- [ ] Explicit consent language is present before any intensive activity
- [ ] Learner opt-out mechanism is clearly described
- [ ] Scope of the activity is bounded (time, depth, context)

### Contraindications and Stop Rules
- [ ] Contraindications are listed (e.g., active trauma, psychiatric crisis)
- [ ] Stop rules are clearly stated (conditions under which the learner should pause or exit)
- [ ] Language is accessible and non-stigmatizing

### Grounding and Alternatives
- [ ] At least one grounding technique is provided
- [ ] A lower-intensity alternative path is offered for Tier 2+ content
- [ ] Grounding is positioned before, during, and after the intensive activity

### Escalation Path
- [ ] Escalation guidance is included (who to contact, how)
- [ ] Crisis resources are referenced where appropriate
- [ ] Facilitator briefing materials exist (Tier 3 only)

### Clinical Boundaries
- [ ] Content does not claim to provide therapy, diagnosis, or clinical care
- [ ] No clinical language is used in a therapeutic context
- [ ] Referral language is appropriate and non-prescriptive
